name: Fact Check
description: Fact check claim by claim, and verify a single source: each checkable claim with the sources that confirm or contradict it and a verdict, or a source traced to its original and rated.
abilities: Pulls out the checkable claims and quotes each one exactly
Looks for the primary source behind every claim and reads it
Gives each claim a verdict from one fixed scale, with the evidence linked
Says plainly what it couldn't check
Traces a claim back to the original source through the copies
Finds the exact passage, figure or quote in the source itself
Checks the publisher, the date and lookalike addresses
Rates the source on a fixed scale and says why
permissions: Uses the Web Search and Web Page Reader plugins when they are on
Uses Knowledge Search to check claims against your own files

changes.notes: Merged with Source Verification, which is part of this skill now.
